_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). UPPAbaby MINU / MINU V2 (compact travel). Uses UPPAbaby-made Maxi-Cosi adapter 0918-MXA-WW (NOT the Clek adapter). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby MINU V2 (covers Minu / Minu V2)

clekListed.clekRow: UPPAbaby Minu / Minu V2 — Car seat adapter for Maxi-Cosi (0918-MXA-WW), UPPAbaby-made (not the Clek adapter)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: ~3 mo+ (upright unassisted) in seat; from birth only with MINU infant car seat adapter/car seat or from-birth kit

safety.notes: 5-point harness; zip-out UPF 50+ canopy; front and rear spring suspension; one-step self-standing fold.

specs.recline: multi-position recline (not fully flat without accessory)
specs.tires: foam-filled never-flat wheels; front swivel with lock; all-wheel spring suspension

notes: Compact travel stroller, ~16.9 lb, one-hand self-standing fold — a genuine city/shopping candidate. Minu/Minu V2 now discontinued (superseded by Minu V3); PBK lists 'No Longer Available', resale ~$299.99, original MSRP ~$399.99 — priceSources marked inStock:false. IMPORTANT: uses UPPAbaby-MADE Maxi-Cosi adapter 0918-MXA-WW (adapter-0918-mxa-ww), NOT the Clek adapter; the Clek Liing mounts via its Maxi-Cosi-style footprint and is listed by name.
